blocks.text: Sulfur rubber ki molecular chains (zanjeer) ko aapas mein jorne wala (cross linker) ka kaam karta hai. Is process ko vulcanisation kehte hain, aur is se rubber mazboot ho jata hai (Figure 12.10).

blocks.alt: Do lambi, uljhi hui orange polymer chains. Chaar jagah S atoms ka ek pair chains ke do hisson ko jorta hai: har S ek chhoti line (lakeer) se chain se jura hai aur dono S aapas mein jure hain. Oopar wala ek S-S pair circle (daira) mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.10: Polymer chains ke darmiyan S-S cross-linkages (kitab ki Figure 12.10 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Vulcanisation se pehle rubber ki chains ek doosre par phisal sakti hain, is liye rubber naram aur chipchipa hota hai. Sulfur S-S bridges (pul) bana kar chains ko jagah jagah bandh deta hai, is liye vulcanised rubber zyada mazboot aur lachakdar hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Rubber ki vulcanisation mein sulfur ka kya role (kirdar) hai (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Kachche rubber ko sulfur ke saath garam karne par sulfur paas paas ki polymer chains ke darmiyan S–S bridges (cross-links) banata hai. Ab chains ek doosre par phisal nahi saktin, is liye rubber zyada mazboot, lachakdar (elastic) aur kam chipchipa ho jata hai.

items: Vulcanisation: sulfur rubber ki chains ko S–S bridges se jorta hai; rubber mazboot hota hai.
